title: Two Brain Pathways Initiate Distinct Forward Walking Programs in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results, 'A neural activation screen identifies candidate walking initiation neurons'; Fig. 1A-F; Fig. S1; Video S1, S2
quote: SS01540 activation elicited forward walking with a strong turning component whereas SS01587 activation induced straight forward walking
mapping_basis: Paper: 'This line labels DNp09 (henceforth referred to as P9) (Namiki et al., 2018)'; DNp09 is a MANC type name but the kit lists 'DNp09' also as the hemibrain name of DNp71 and SS01540 as AMBIGUOUS (DNp09;DNp71); the paper uses Namiki 2018 nomenclature and the split line from that collection, so DNp09 chosen.
stimulation: Screen: continuous white light 0.5 mW/cm2 throughout a 7-min assay; retest: 630 nm ~4.5 mW/cm2 pulsed 50 Hz (5 ms), 30 s ON x3 (grooming assay) or 10 s ON x3 (copulation assay)
type_coverage: a pair of ipsilateral DNs (one cell per hemisphere)
sensory_condition: bowl-shaped arena; powdered (grooming) flies or females in copulation; retest in the dark
other_cell_types: a few additional neurons (Figures S2A and S2B)
mushroom body gamma lobe neurites (CsChrimson quantification, Fig. S2G)
penetrance: SS01540 'reliably initiated walking in powdered flies'; females 'reliably initiated walking' mid-copulation
n_flies_note: screen n=12-16 per genotype per condition; grooming retest n=16-24 flies/genotype; copulation n=9-11 flies/genotype
notes: Walking initiation in non-walking (grooming or copulating) flies; centroid tracking (FlyTracker), no leg tracking. Continuous-light screen (Fig. 1A-B), acute retest in grooming flies (Fig. 1C, E) and copulating females (Fig. 1D, F) are coded together as one Fig. 1 experiment with the same outcome. Walking coded yes for all leg pairs per convention.

title: Two Brain Pathways Initiate Distinct Forward Walking Programs in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results, 'P9 DNs initiate forward walking with an ipsilateral turning component'; Fig. 2C
quote: mosaic animals with CsChrimson stochastically expressed in both P9 neurons initiated walking with turns in both directions on activation (Figure 2C)
mapping_basis: Paper names the SS01540 neuron DNp09 (Namiki 2018) and calls it P9; kit lists DNp09 name and SS01540 as ambiguous DNp09/DNp71; Namiki nomenclature supports DNp09.
stimulation: 630 nm ~4.5 mW/cm2 pulsed 50 Hz (5 ms) (default transient activation protocol)
other_cell_types: a few additional neurons labelled by SS01540 (Figures S2A and S2B); whether mosaics expressed in them is not stated
notes: Stochastic (flip-out) CsChrimson in SS01540; bilateral-P9 mosaics. Walking initiated with turns in both directions.

title: Two Brain Pathways Initiate Distinct Forward Walking Programs in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results, 'P9 DNs initiate forward walking with an ipsilateral turning component'; Fig. 2D-E; Video S3
quote: all animals that expressed CsChrimson unilaterally in the right P9 initiated forward walking with rightward turns (Figure 2D)
mapping_basis: Paper names the SS01540 neuron DNp09 (Namiki 2018) and calls it P9; kit lists DNp09 name and SS01540 as ambiguous DNp09/DNp71; Namiki nomenclature supports DNp09.
stimulation: 630 nm ~4.5 mW/cm2 pulsed 50 Hz (5 ms) (default transient activation protocol)
other_cell_types: a few additional neurons labelled by SS01540 (Figures S2A and S2B); whether mosaics expressed in them is not stated
coordination_notes: forward walking with ipsilateral turns (right P9 -> rightward, left P9 -> leftward)
penetrance: all unilateral right-P9 animals turned right; left-P9 animals turned left
n_flies_note: right P9: 10 flies, 30 trials; left P9: 9 flies, 27 trials
notes: Unilateral activation initiates forward walking with ipsilateral turning; paper concludes 'P9 is the causal neuron in the split-Gal4 (SS01540) line'.

title: Two Brain Pathways Initiate Distinct Forward Walking Programs in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results, 'P9 DNs initiate forward walking with an ipsilateral turning component'; Fig. S2E
quote: Activating P9S2 neurons induced a walking initiation phenotype with a strong turning component similar to SS01540 (Figure S2E)
mapping_basis: P9S2 is listed in driver_lines.csv as AMBIGUOUS (DNp09;DNp71) with name as written DNp09; paper's P9 = Namiki DNp09.
stimulation: 630 nm ~4.5 mW/cm2 pulsed 50 Hz (5 ms) (default transient activation protocol)
sensory_condition: presumably powdered/grooming flies (walking initiation assay); not explicitly stated
notes: P9S2 = VT005105-p65ADZp(attp40); VT023490-ZpGal4DBD(attp2) (key resources table, 'This study'); paper says it 'targets P9 but does not share off-target cells with SS01540' (own off-targets, if any, not described in text). Figure S2 not available in the room.

title: Two Brain Pathways Initiate Distinct Forward Walking Programs in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results, 'P9 DNs initiate forward walking with an ipsilateral turning component'; Fig. S2A-D, S2F; STAR Methods 'Freezing Assay'
quote: freezing was observed in only one genotype, although all genotypes strongly label P9 and initiate walking on neural activation
mapping_basis: Paper's P9 = DNp09 (Namiki 2018); kit lists the name and P9 lines as ambiguous DNp09/DNp71; Namiki nomenclature supports DNp09.
effector: CsChrimson (four driver/reporter combinations, e.g. attP18 and attP2 CsChrimson.mVenus)
stimulation: Freezing assay: ~2.5 mW/cm2 red light, 10 repetitions of 2 s continuous ON / 10 s OFF (matched to Zacarias et al. 2018)
sensory_condition: flat hard acrylic arena without serrated walls (flies could walk on walls)
other_cell_types: off-target neurons labelled by the freezing genotype (Figure S2G; gamma lobe expression in SS01540)
penetrance: all four genotypes initiated walking; freezing in only one genotype
notes: Four driver/reporter genotypes tested (Table S1 not available, so exact genotype-to-line mapping is uncertain; SS01540 and P9S2 are the P9 drivers in the paper). 'in all cases, optogenetic stimulation increased both forward and angular velocity'. One genotype also showed freezing after walking, attributed possibly to high CsChrimson expression or off-target neurons.

title: Two Brain Pathways Initiate Distinct Forward Walking Programs in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results, 'P9 DNs initiate forward walking with an ipsilateral turning component'; Fig. S2H-I

title: Two Brain Pathways Initiate Distinct Forward Walking Programs in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results, 'P9 neurons are essential for object directed walking during courtship'; Fig. 4E-H; Video S4; STAR Methods 'Remote-controlled female courtship assay'
quote: The “remote-controlled” female was intermittently triggered to perform sudden forward walking and turning via P9 activation throughout the assay
mapping_basis: Paper's P9 = DNp09 (Namiki 2018) labelled by SS01540; kit lists SS01540 as ambiguous DNp09/DNp71; Namiki nomenclature supports DNp09.
stimulation: 630 nm light, 10 s OFF / 20 s ON for 10 min (intensity/pulsing per default transient protocol, ~4.5 mW/cm2, 50 Hz)
sensory_condition: virgin female paired with a courting male; diffuse room lighting
other_cell_types: a few additional neurons (Figures S2A and S2B)
mushroom body gamma lobe neurites (Fig. S2G)
notes: Female velocity traces shown in Fig. 4G; the experiment's focus is male pursuit, but female P9 activation triggers 'high forward and angular velocity walking' (Methods).
